description: Calls any of the 380 Genesis402 endpoints by name (DeFi, SEC filings, research, web/domain intel, AI text tools, multi-chain reads). Prices $0.001-$0.25 USDC on Base. Use for any endpoint without a dedicated tool; look up the name and parameters with genesis402_catalog first. Parameters are validated for free before any quote. Without payment_signature (or a local payer) it returns the exact price quote and signs nothing; with payment it returns the result plus the settlement details.

endpoint.description: Endpoint name exactly as listed by genesis402_catalog, e.g. "defi-yields" or "wallet-brief" (a leading slash is ignored).

params.description: Parameters for that endpoint as an object, matching the parameter schema shown in genesis402_catalog. Omit if the endpoint takes none.

payment_signature.description: Optional. An x402 v2 payment you signed for this call's quote (the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value). Omit to get the price quote first; nothing is charged without it.

name: genesis402_call

also_accepted_networks.description: QUOTE_ONLY: every network the 402 challenge accepts.

how_to_pay.description: QUOTE_ONLY: how to sign and resend the call.

mode.description: QUOTE_ONLY: price quote only, nothing signed or charged. PAID: the call was paid and result holds the data. FREE: the endpoint answered without payment.

paid.description: true only when a payment was settled for this call.

payment_required_b64.description: QUOTE_ONLY: the raw base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, to sign with any x402 v2 client.

atomic.description: Price in USDC atomic units (6 decimals), as a decimal string.

network.description: CAIP-2 network id of the lane, eip155:8453 (Base).

price.description: The Base USDC quote. Present on QUOTE_ONLY and on PAID calls made by a local payer; null when the rail offered no Base USDC lane or the caller signed the payment.

receipts_url.description: Public receipts feed, where a paid call's signed receipt can be looked up.

resource.description: QUOTE_ONLY: the full URL of the paid resource.

result.description: PAID or FREE: the endpoint's JSON result.

seller.description: Who is paid and who issues the receipt: the seller's ERC-8004 agent id, registry and receipts feed.

agent_id.description: ERC-8004 agent id of the seller on Base. 95721 is the Genesis402 rail; a route sold by a desk agent names that agent.

collector.description: ERC-8004 id of the collecting agent whose wallet receives the payment (95721). Present with specialist.

pay_to.description: The Base address this route is paid to, as quoted in the 402.

receipts.description: Public feed of signed receipts for paid calls.

registry.description: CAIP-10 style registry reference, eip155:8453:<IdentityRegistry address>.

registry_address.description: ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry contract address on Base.

source.description: rail: named by the rail in its 402 or manifest. package: this package's default, used when the rail names none.

specialist.description: Present when the route is sold by one of the rail's eight specialists (prices, chain-reader, defi, web, geo-records, research, ai-tools, utilities).

settlement.description: PAID: decoded PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement (transaction hash, network, payer), or null if the rail sent none.

what_you_get.description: QUOTE_ONLY: the rail's description of what the payment buys.

title: Call any endpoint
